title: Broken Help nav link returns 404
how_to_find: Click Help in the top nav from any page; expect /help to exist.

title: IDOR: /rides lists every user's rides
how_to_find: Log in as alice, book a ride; log in as bob and open /rides — alice's ride is visible.

title: IDOR: /rides/<id> has no ownership check
how_to_find: As bob, open /rides/<alice_ride_id> directly and see alice's pickup/dropoff.

title: Any user can cancel another user's ride
how_to_find: As bob, POST /rides/<alice_id>/cancel and watch the status flip to cancelled.

title: Negative tip accepted, fare can go negative
how_to_find: On a ride detail page submit tip amount = -100; fare becomes negative.

title: Admin panel reachable without auth
how_to_find: While logged out, open /admin and see the user table.

title: Admin panel renders plaintext passwords
how_to_find: Open /admin and look at the Password column.

title: Reflected XSS on /estimate?q=
how_to_find: Open /estimate?q=<script>alert(1)</script> and observe the payload echoed unescaped.

title: SQL-injection shaped 500 on /search
how_to_find: Open /search?q=x' OR 1=1-- and get a raw sqlite error page.

title: Unauthenticated JSON IDOR on /api/rides/<id>
how_to_find: With no cookie, GET /api/rides/1 and receive the full ride object.

title: debug_token cookie set without HttpOnly
how_to_find: After login inspect Set-Cookie: debug_token — HttpOnly is missing.
